title: Patient registers with a mobile number
user_story: As a patient, I want to register with my mobile number so that I can book without visiting reception.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new mobile number, when the patient enters the one-time code sent by SMS, then an account is created and the patient is signed in.

title: Patient signs in with a one-time code
user_story: As a patient, I want to sign in with a code sent to my phone so that I do not have to remember a password.
acceptance_criteria: Given a registered number, when the patient enters a valid code within 5 minutes, then they are signed in; when the code has expired, then they are asked to request a new one.

title: Staff sign in with individual accounts
user_story: As a receptionist, I want my own login so that my actions are recorded against my name and not a shared account.
acceptance_criteria: Given a staff member with an active account, when they sign in, then the audit log records their user ID for every action in the session.

title: Role-based access for clinicians
user_story: As the Data Protection Officer, I want each role to see only the data it needs so that we meet the Data Protection Act.
acceptance_criteria: Given a receptionist, when they open a patient, then clinical notes are hidden; given a doctor at the same facility, then they are shown.

title: Patient gives consent before processing
user_story: As a patient, I want to see and accept how my data will be used before I register so that I can make an informed choice.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new patient, when they have not accepted the consent notice, then no personal data is saved.

title: Reception registers a patient on their behalf
user_story: As a receptionist, I want to register a walk-in patient so that patients without smartphones can still use the service.

title: Patient withdraws consent
user_story: As a patient, I want to withdraw my consent so that CareGrid stops processing my data for optional purposes.

title: Clinician account is locked after failed sign-ins
user_story: As the Data Protection Officer, I want accounts locked after repeated failed sign-ins so that guessing passwords does not work.

title: Patient books an in-person appointment
user_story: As a patient, I want to book an appointment at my chosen facility so that I do not have to queue to book.
acceptance_criteria: Given a free slot, when the patient confirms, then the slot is reserved and a confirmation is shown; given a slot already booked, then the patient is offered the next free slots.

title: Patient books a video appointment with a named doctor
user_story: As a patient, I want to book a video appointment with a named doctor so that I can see the doctor I know.
acceptance_criteria: Given the doctor has free video slots, when the patient selects one and confirms, then the booking appears in the doctor's clinic list.

title: Patient reschedules an appointment
user_story: As a patient, I want to move my appointment to another time so that I do not miss it.
acceptance_criteria: Given a booking more than 2 hours away, when the patient picks a new free slot, then the old slot is released and the new one reserved.

title: Patient cancels an appointment
user_story: As a patient, I want to cancel an appointment so that the slot can be used by someone else.
acceptance_criteria: Given a booking, when the patient cancels, then the slot becomes free and the clinic list is updated.

title: Two staff cannot book the same slot
user_story: As a receptionist, I want the system to stop two people booking the same slot at the same moment so that patients are not double-booked.
acceptance_criteria: Given two booking requests for the same clinician and slot at the same time, when both are submitted, then exactly one succeeds and the other is offered the next free slot.
notes: Added after the pilot double booking (Chapter 8)

title: Reception sees the daily clinic list
user_story: As a receptionist, I want a daily list of bookings for my facility so that I can prepare for the day.

title: Doctor blocks out unavailable time
user_story: As a doctor, I want to block time when I am not available so that patients cannot book it.

title: Patient joins a waiting list for a full clinic
user_story: As a patient, I want to join a waiting list when no slots are free so that I am offered a cancellation.

title: Patient sees upcoming appointments
user_story: As a patient, I want to see my upcoming appointments so that I know when and where to go.

title: Reception books for a patient by phone
user_story: As a receptionist, I want to book an appointment for a patient who calls so that patients without the app are served.

title: Doctor opens a patient record from the clinic list
user_story: As a doctor, I want to open a booked patient's record from my clinic list so that I can prepare quickly.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient in today's list, when the doctor selects them, then the record opens in no more than two actions.

title: Doctor sees a patient's visit history
user_story: As a doctor, I want to see a patient's previous visits so that I understand their history.
acceptance_criteria: Given a migrated patient, when the doctor opens the history, then visits from CareBook and HealthSync are shown in date order.

title: Every read of a record is logged
user_story: As the Data Protection Officer, I want every read of a patient record logged so that we can show who saw what.
acceptance_criteria: Given any user, when they open a patient record, then an audit entry with user, time, record and facility is written.

title: Patient updates contact details
user_story: As a patient, I want to update my phone number and address so that the clinic can reach me.

title: Doctor records the outcome of a visit
user_story: As a doctor, I want to record the outcome of a visit so that it appears in the patient's history.

title: Records are visible only at the patient's facilities
user_story: As the Data Protection Officer, I want staff at one clinic unable to see another clinic's records unless the patient has been referred so that access is limited to need.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user at Ndola, when they request a record held only at Chipata, then access is refused and logged.

title: Patient joins from an SMS link
user_story: As a patient, I want to join my video consultation from a link in an SMS so that I do not need to find the app.
acceptance_criteria: Given a video booking, when the patient opens the link up to 10 minutes before the start, then they enter the waiting room.

title: Doctor sees who is waiting
user_story: As a doctor holding a video clinic, I want to see which booked patients are waiting so that I can call them in order.
acceptance_criteria: Given patients in the waiting room, when the doctor opens the clinic, then waiting patients are listed with their booking time.

title: Doctor admits a waiting patient
user_story: As a doctor, I want to admit a waiting patient to the call when I am ready so that I control when each consultation starts.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient in the waiting room, when the doctor selects Admit, then the call starts and other waiting patients stay in the waiting room.

title: Doctor ends the call and records the outcome
user_story: As a doctor, I want to end the call and record its outcome so that the visit appears in the patient's history.
acceptance_criteria: Given a call in progress, when the doctor ends it, then the outcome form opens and the visit is saved to the history.

title: Call switches to audio-only on a weak connection
user_story: As a patient on a slow connection, I want the call to continue as audio so that my consultation is not lost.
acceptance_criteria: Given a video call, when bandwidth falls below 150 kbps, then the call switches to audio-only within 5 seconds.

title: End-to-end video call from Kabwe on mobile data
user_story: As the project team, we want an end-to-end call from Kabwe clinic over a mobile connection so that we test the biggest risk early.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test patient at Kabwe on 3G, when they join a call with a doctor in Lusaka, then the call completes with audio throughout.
notes: Risk spike, ordered near the top

title: Patient tests camera and microphone before the call
user_story: As a patient, I want to check my camera and microphone before the call so that I am ready when the doctor admits me.

title: Doctor invites a specialist into the call
user_story: As a provincial doctor, I want to bring a Lusaka specialist into the call so that the patient does not have to travel.

title: Patient rejoins after a dropped call
user_story: As a patient, I want to rejoin the same call if my connection drops so that the consultation can continue.

title: Patient pays by mobile money
user_story: As a patient, I want to pay for my consultation by mobile money so that I do not need a card.
acceptance_criteria: Given a booking that needs payment, when the patient approves the PayBridge prompt on their phone, then the booking is marked paid within 30 seconds.

title: Patient pays by card
user_story: As a patient, I want to pay by card so that I can use my bank account.
notes: Split by data variation: mobile money first

title: Failed payment does not confirm a booking
user_story: As the Finance Director, I want unpaid bookings to stay unconfirmed so that we are not giving free consultations by mistake.
acceptance_criteria: Given a payment that PayBridge declines, when the response arrives, then the booking stays unpaid and the patient is told why.

title: Patient receives a receipt
user_story: As a patient, I want a receipt by SMS so that I can claim from my insurer or employer.

title: Finance reconciles daily payments
user_story: As the Finance Director, I want a daily report matching PayBridge settlements to bookings so that every payment is accounted for.

title: Refund for a cancelled paid appointment
user_story: As a patient, I want a refund when the clinic cancels a paid appointment so that I am not out of pocket.

title: Profile CareBook patient data
user_story: As the migration team, we want a profile of CareBook's patient tables so that we know the duplicates, gaps and free-text problems before we write scripts.
acceptance_criteria: Given a copy of CareBook, when profiling runs, then a report shows counts, null rates and suspected duplicates by facility.

title: Merge duplicate patients
user_story: As the DBA, I want suspected duplicate patients merged under agreed rules so that each patient has one record.
acceptance_criteria: Given two records with the same NRC number and date of birth, when the merge runs, then one record remains with both visit histories.

title: Migrate visit records
user_story: As the migration team, we want visit records from the last seven years migrated so that doctors see the history they need.
acceptance_criteria: Given a migration run, when it completes, then visit counts and checksums match CareBook for each facility.

title: Reconciliation report after each rehearsal
user_story: As the CIO, I want a reconciliation report after each rehearsal so that we can prove nothing was lost.

title: Convert free-text allergies to coded values
user_story: As a doctor, I want allergies migrated as coded values where possible so that warnings work in the new system.

title: CareBook kept read-only after cutover
user_story: As the CIO, I want CareBook available read-only for 12 months so that staff can check anything the migration missed.

title: Migrate facility and clinician reference data
user_story: As the migration team, we want facilities, clinicians and clinic templates migrated first so that patient data has something to attach to.
acceptance_criteria: Given the reference tables, when migrated, then every facility and active clinician exists in HealthSync with a CareBook cross-reference.

title: Deployment pipeline with quality gate
user_story: As the team, we want every merge to run build, tests and a SonarQube quality gate so that defects are caught before they reach the pilot.
acceptance_criteria: Given a pull request, when the pipeline runs, then the merge is blocked if any test fails or the quality gate fails.

title: Encrypt patient data at rest
user_story: As the Data Protection Officer, I want patient data encrypted at rest so that a stolen disk exposes nothing.
acceptance_criteria: Given the production database, when inspected, then storage encryption is enabled with keys managed by CareGrid.

title: Load test the booking service at Monday peak
user_story: As the CIO, I want the booking service load-tested at three times the Monday peak so that it does not crash like CareBook.

title: Restore drill for the production database
user_story: As the CIO, I want a full restore tested before go-live so that we know we can recover within four hours.

title: Accessibility checks on the web portal
user_story: As a receptionist with low vision, I want the portal to meet WCAG 2.2 AA so that I can use it.

title: Home screen loads in 3 seconds on 3G
user_story: As a patient on mobile data, I want the app to open quickly so that I do not give up.
acceptance_criteria: Given a 3G connection, when the patient opens the app, then the home screen loads within 3 seconds for 95% of requests.
